## A resource pack that tweaks and adds compatabilities to [Barebones](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones).
The Barebones mod creates a trailer-inspired experience whilst playing the base game. This pack aims to extend that immersion to modded minecraft by compiling several compatabilities into one place.


### Current Vanilla Tweaks
- Changes the textures for normal and packed ice.

### Mod Compatabilities
- [Analog Audio](https://modrinth.com/mod/analog-audio)
- [Joy of Painting](https://modrinth.com/mod/joy-of-painting/versions)
- [Vanilla Backport](https://modrinth.com/mod/vanillabackport)
